name: CircleCI
summary: CircleCI is a hosted CI/CD service that bills in credits. Free and Performance both include 30,000 credits a month and 5 active users. Performance starts at $15 a month and sells extra credits at $15 per 25,000. Scale is quote only and billed annually.

facts.text: Free and Performance each include 30,000 credits a month, which expire monthly and do not roll over.
Self-hosted runners are not charged per build minute. Network overage costs 420 credits per GB.
CircleCI's pricing page lists extra Performance users at $15 a month in one place and 25,000 credits per month in the plan table, and does not reconcile the two.
On January 4, 2023 CircleCI disclosed that an attacker had taken customer environment variables, tokens and keys, and told customers to rotate every secret stored in it.
The Rerun job with SSH option lets an engineer inspect log files, running processes and directories on a failed job.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 30,000 credits a month, 5 active users, 5 self-hosted concurrent tasks. No credit card required

plans.name: Performance
plans.notes: Starting at $15 a month. 30,000 credits a month, 5 active users, 20 self-hosted concurrent tasks. Extra credits $15 per 25,000

hiddenCosts: Credits expire monthly, so unused free credits are lost.
Prepaid credits are sold in blocks, 1 million for $600, and stay valid for up to 12 months.
Prices do not include applicable taxes.
